environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). The ELB performs health checks on /health and forwards all other traffic directly to the application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ELB, and ELB to instance on 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering layer. SQLite database is local on the instance EBS volume.

config.security_groups: sg-elb: inbound 443/tcp 0.0.0.0/0; sg-instance: inbound 8080/tcp from sg-elb
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
